Yearn is a yield aggregator built on Ethereum smart contracts. Yearn deposits user funds into vaults that allocate capital across lending protocols to seek yield. Yearn is governed through its YFI governance token. Yearn was launched in 2020.

Idle is a yield optimization protocol built on Ethereum smart contracts. Idle allocates deposited funds across lending protocols such as Compound and Aave to seek the best rate. Idle offers risk-tranched strategies with AA and BB tranches. Idle is governed through its IDLE governance token.

Harvest is a yield aggregator built on Ethereum smart contracts. Harvest automatically compounds farming rewards for its users. Harvest is governed through its FARM governance token. Harvest suffered a flash loan exploit in October 2020.

Pickle is a yield optimizer built on Ethereum smart contracts. Pickle auto-compounds rewards from liquidity pool tokens deposited in Pickle Jars. Pickle is governed through its PICKLE token. Pickle suffered a flash loan exploit in November 2020.
